stem.text: Let \( f(x) = \begin{cases} \frac{x^{2} - 1}{x - 1}, & x < 1 \\ kx + m, & 1 \le x \le 2 \\ - 2 x^{2}, & x > 2 \end{cases} \), where k and m are constants. Find the values of k and m for which f is continuous for all real numbers.

answer_key.label: \( k = -10 \) and \( m = 12 \), because the middle branch must equal 2 at \( x = 1 \) and -8 at \( x = 2 \).

worked_solution.text: For \( x < 1 \), \( \frac{x^{2} - 1}{x - 1} = x + 1 \), so the limit from the left at \( x = 1 \) is 2. The middle branch gives \( f(1) = 1k + m \), so \( 1k + m = 2 \).
worked_solution.rule_named: match the branches at the first boundary

worked_solution.text: At \( x = 2 \) the middle branch gives \( f(2) = 2k + m \) and the last branch approaches -8, so \( 2k + m = -8 \).
worked_solution.rule_named: match the branches at the second boundary

worked_solution.text: Subtracting the equations gives \( k = -10 \), and then \( m = 12 \).

options.label: \( k = 1 \) and \( m = 1 \), because the middle branch must equal 2 at \( x = 1 \) and 3 at \( x = 2 \).
options.derivation: at x = 2 the first branch, which applies only for x < 1, used in place of the last branch

No values of k and m work, because \( \frac{x^{2} - 1}{x - 1} \) is undefined at \( x = 1 \), so f has no limit there.
options.derivation: the first branch is undefined at x = 1, and that was taken to mean its limit there does not exist
